q: What should an EU importer ask a Turkish cement supplier for?
title: EU importers: Turkish cement data
short: Ask for direct and indirect specific embedded emissions per tonne for each cement type, the clinker share and its origin, the electricity factor used, the reporting period and whether figures are verified. Cement is charged on both direct and indirect emissions.
audience: EU importers buying cement and clinker from Turkey

ul: Specific direct embedded emissions per tonne of cement, by CN code.
Specific indirect emissions and the electricity factor applied.
Clinker share, and for bought clinker its producer's figure or the default.
Reporting period, installation name and verification status.

p: If the producer paid a carbon price in Turkey, ask for evidence. A carbon price effectively paid in the country of origin can reduce the certificates owed, under strict conditions.
Default values with the yearly mark up apply. For a lower clinker cement, that usually costs more than actual data.
